feeds.title: FlyerTalk
feeds.description: FlyerTalk is an interactive community that provides up-to-date information on travel and industry news. We are a living, growing community where frequent travelers around the world come to exchange knowledge and experiences about everything miles and points related.

feeds.title: The Points Guy
feeds.description: The Points Guy (TPG) has been publishing hands-on advice to help readers maximize their travel experiences since the site debuted in June 2010. What started out as a points-and-miles blog by founder and CEO Brian Kelly has evolved into a lifestyle media brand with 10 million unique visitors a month and a social media audience of over 3 million across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn and Twitter.

feeds.title: Johnny Jet
feeds.description: Johnny Jet travels around 150,000 miles and visits 20 countries each year. This is the place where travel experts share their tips and expertise to make you the expert. It's also a place to have fun, explore, learn, and just kick back.

feeds.title: Point Hacks
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with The best guides, deals and tips for frequent flyers.

feeds.title: BoardingArea
feeds.description: Founded in 1986, Frequent Flyer Services has created a unique niche for itself within the travel industry as a company that conceives, develops and markets products and services exclusively for the frequent traveler. For more than 25 years, we have been providing news, information and advice for frequent flyers. Our goal has always been to provide frequent travelers with the information needed to make the most of their travel.

feeds.title: The High Life
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with Insights and hacks for stylish travel - points tips, premium airfare deals, airline and hotel reviews and more.

feeds.title: Australian Frequent Flyer
feeds.description: Covering topics ranging from airlines, miles and points and loyalty programs, to travel lifestyle and trip reports and reviews. The Australian Frequent Flyer is Australia's leading Frequent Flyer community and Travel website, comprising of travelers who discuss travel experiences and receive discounts on car hire, travel insurance, lounge memberships.

feeds.title: InsideFlyer
feeds.description: InsideFlyer is a privately funded venture based in Colorado Springs, CO. We're a small diverse group of experienced frequent flyer experts, travel community builders, technologists, and friends of the flyer who want to help you learn to be an expert traveler.

feeds.title: Frequent Flyer Bonuses Blog
feeds.description: The Frequent Flyer Bonuses websites are the most comprehensive guide of travel reward program bonus offers on the Internet. Whether you are flying, sleeping, driving, buying or anything else that can earn miles or points, if there is a bonus you'll find it here.

feeds.title: Kara and Nate
feeds.description: Hi, we're Kara and Nate! We're full-time travelers and YouTubers sharing our adventures.
